title: Restrict inventory updates to administrators
intent: Allow only administrators to update product inventory.
acceptance_criteria: A non-admin authenticated user calling the inventory-adjust endpoint is rejected with 403
An admin calling the inventory-adjust endpoint still succeeds
expected_risks: This endpoint is the one write operation in the API that does not yet use the existing require_admin dependency, unlike products.py's equivalent endpoints
expected_failure_modes: adjust_inventory depends on get_current_user instead of require_admin (current gap)
